issues.location: Recomendações de produto representam 10-30% da receita de e-commerce (McKinsey). O AOV médio em lojas com cross-sell ativo sobe 8-15% (Baymard Institute).
issues.explanation: Both of these are debunked fabricated benchmarks. The '10-30% of e-commerce revenue from recommendations' was never published by McKinsey in the form commonly cited. The '8-15% AOV uplift with cross-sell' was never published by Baymard Institute. Both are flagged on the explicit debunked list.

issues.location: produtos com 50+ reviews convertem 2-3x mais do que produtos sem reviews (Bazaarvoice / Spiegel)
issues.explanation: The Spiegel Research Center finding is about 5 reviews producing a 270% conversion lift, not '50+ reviews converting 2-3x more'. The '50+ reviews = 2-3x' formulation is a debunked misrepresentation of the original stat and is explicitly on the flagged list.

issues.location: O AOV médio em lojas com cross-sell ativo sobe 8-15% (Baymard Institute).
issues.explanation: The 8-15% AOV uplift attributed to Baymard Institute for cross-sell is a fabricated benchmark that Baymard has never published. This is explicitly listed as a debunked stat.

summary: The report passes most checks but contains three fabricated benchmark violations in Section 4 (cross-sell), all of which are on the explicit debunked list: the McKinsey '10-30% revenue from recommendations', the Baymard '8-15% AOV uplift', and the Spiegel '50+ reviews = 2-3x conversion' misquote.

edits.original: Recomendações de produto representam 10-30% da receita de e-commerce (McKinsey). O AOV médio em lojas com cross-sell ativo sobe 8-15% (Baymard Institute).
edits.fixed: Segundo a McKinsey (2021), personalização gera um aumento de receita de 5-15%.
edits.rationale: The McKinsey '10-30% of e-commerce revenue' claim is fabricated. Replaced with the verified McKinsey 2021 personalization stat. The Baymard '8-15% AOV uplift' claim is also fabricated and has no verified source, so it is removed entirely per instructions.

edits.original: produtos com 50+ reviews convertem 2-3x mais do que produtos sem reviews (Bazaarvoice / Spiegel)

edits.rationale: The '50+ reviews = 2-3x conversion' formulation is a misrepresentation of the Spiegel finding. Replaced with the correct Spiegel Research Center (2017) stat: 5+ reviews → 270% higher purchase likelihood.
